claim_text: Independent contemporaneous courthouse reporting states that Said Shafii Farah and Abdiwahab Maalim Aftin were acquitted of all charges against them in the June 7, 2024 Feeding Our Future jury trial in No. 22-CR-124. FOX 9's count-by-count verdict matrix reports Said Farah not guilty on all nine counts assigned to him (Counts 1, 12, 13, 16, 18, 19, 20, 21, and 40) and Aftin not guilty on all three counts assigned to him (Counts 1, 20, and 27). Those denominators align with the captured ECF 57 superseding indictment. The verdict outcome remains SECONDARY_VERIFIED pending capture of the court's verdict forms, minute entry, or another primary judicial record.

supporting_passages.quote: were acquitted of all charges against them
Said Shafii Farah - Not guilty on all counts
Aftin was found not guilty of all three counts.

qualifiers: SECONDARY_VERIFIED source quality despite adjudicated legal event
primary ECF 57 establishes the nine-count Said Farah and three-count Aftin charging denominators, but not the verdict outcome

Minnesota Reformer independently supports the full-acquittal outcome but its later 'all eight charges' phrase for Said Farah conflicts with the primary indictment and FOX 9 matrix and should not be used as the count denominator
supersede or corroborate with verdict forms, minute entry, judgment, or other primary court record when retrieved
do not infer count-by-count acquittals for the five convicted defendants from this claim
editorial_notes: USAO-MN's June 7 release names only the five convicted defendants and therefore does not independently establish the identities of the two fully acquitted defendants. This claim intentionally separates primary evidence of what counts were charged from secondary evidence of the jury's not-guilty verdicts.
